recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. No further Encounter source change is indicated for FHIR-32391; do not publish a duplicate FHIR-23843 decision because the combined branch already contains its audit commit and the CareTeam element remains intact.
issue_request: FHIR-32391 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested moving Encounter.partOf and Encounter.serviceProvider up from the bottom so the order would follow the Event pattern as basedOn, partOf, serviceProvider.
initial_application: Git commit a9d012838c4d8b931a463eb4ff3a3f869aeee6e0 initially applied the issue by moving Encounter.partOf and Encounter.serviceProvider below Encounter.basedOn in source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml. Later commit a573cb7b56ddd13c798c3cc8242784754ed5a5ea for FHIR-23843 inserted Encounter.careTeam between basedOn and partOf, partially disrupting the approved FHIR-32391 sequence.
additional_context: FHIR-23843 separately requires Encounter.careTeam 0..* Reference(CareTeam) between basedOn and participant, and that issue is already audited on the combined branch. The FHIR-32391 Confluence minutes match the Jira disposition, and the Event pattern source places Event.basedOn before Event.partOf while Encounter.serviceProvider maps to Event.performer.actor.
reconciliation: Moved the existing Encounter.careTeam element block to follow Encounter.serviceProvider. The resulting order is Encounter.basedOn, Encounter.partOf, Encounter.serviceProvider, Encounter.careTeam, Encounter.participant, which satisfies FHIR-32391 and keeps careTeam between basedOn and participant for FHIR-23843.
source_changes: source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml: moved the existing Encounter.careTeam element block from between Encounter.basedOn and Encounter.partOf to between Encounter.serviceProvider and Encounter.participant.
